glm-flash.profile: Budget background option for bounded research, inventories, and audits with cited tool evidence. Prefer sol for implementation or reasoning-heavy work. AA Intelligence 41.8, Terminal-Bench 4.0 32.8%. Omniscience accuracy 27.5%, hallucination rate 27.6%: low hallucination reflects abstention, not superior knowledge. Historically 11 s median per local turn on Sept 28; AA first-answer latency 46.9 s. Not a fast foreground default. AA API task cost $0.253 is not subscription quota usage.

muse-spark.profile: Free route for bounded background research and a different-family review when quota matters. Prefer sol for terminal implementation. AA max: Intelligence 48.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0 33.3%, SciCode 58.8%; xhigh terminal score is only 16.7%. AA API throughput 174 tokens/s and first-answer latency 45 s do not measure this free route. Omniscience accuracy 43.6%, hallucination 32.9%. Contributor-free service may be slow or unavailable. No paid API-cost claim applies to this route.

luna.profile: First choice only for deterministic mechanical tasks: exact commands, listings, copying, formatting, and simple searches verified by tool output. Historical local median 4 s per turn. Use low or the lowest supported effort. For judgment, implementation, debugging, or factual synthesis choose sol instead. AA high/max: Intelligence 32.2/37.3, Terminal-Bench 4.0 4.5/12.6%. Omniscience max accuracy 43.8%, hallucination 76.7%. Cheap API usage does not establish subscription quota cost.

sonnet.profile: Claude alternative for bounded implementation and independent review of OpenAI-authored changes; use high when substantial reasoning is needed. Sol medium beats Sonnet high on AA terminal coding, so Sonnet is not the routine coding default. Specialist for difficult terminal-agent work at xhigh; max is a deliberate expensive escalation, not a default. AA high/xhigh/max: Intelligence 46.7/51.9/56.0, Terminal-Bench 4.0 43.9/57.1/63.6%. Max leads this terminal benchmark, but Opus leads broad intelligence and SciCode. AA API task costs $1.08/$2.74/$7.60 are not Claude quota measurements. Local latency is unmeasured. UI/UX always goes to Opus.

sol.profile: GPT-6.1 Sol replaces GPT-6 Sol. First choice for general-purpose coding and evidence-backed research: low for bounded research/docs, medium for routine implementation/tests, high for hard coding/debugging, xhigh for exceptional correctness. Supports low/medium/high/xhigh/max, not off/minimal. AA low/medium/high/xhigh/max: Intelligence 42.1/47.8/50.2/51.0/51.8; Terminal-Bench 4.0 30.8/48.0/51.5/54.0/56.1%. Medium beats old Sol max on terminal coding. AA API task costs $0.131/$0.214/$0.319/$0.393/$0.724; these are not Codex quota measurements. Local latency is unmeasured; old Sol timings and history are not measurements of 6.1. AA first-answer latency rises from 5.3 s at medium to 57.3 s at high and 204.6 s at max. Opus remains the broad high-stakes and UI/UX choice; Astra is a specialist escalation, not the routine default.

opus.profile: First choice for UI/UX design and implementation (user requirement), broad difficult architecture, and high-stakes cross-family review of OpenAI code. Prefer sol for ordinary coding to preserve shared Claude quota. Medium for bounded difficult work, high for subtle correctness, xhigh only for exceptional tasks. AA medium/high/xhigh/max: Intelligence 51.2/53.6/56.0/57.6; Terminal-Bench 4.0 52.5/56.6/59.6/59.6%; SciCode 59.3/60.4/65.1/66.9%. Best broad intelligence and SciCode in this comparison, not the highest terminal score. Historical local median 7-10 s per turn; no local comparison to Sol 6.1 yet. Omniscience max accuracy 66.2%, hallucination 58.6%. API task costs $1.34/$1.82/$3.46/$5.98 are not subscription quota measurements.

astra.profile: Specialist OpenAI escalation for hard correctness/security and independent review of Claude-authored code; prefer sol for routine work. High for careful review, xhigh for exceptional terminal reasoning. AA high/xhigh/max: Intelligence 50.9/52.4/52.7; Terminal-Bench 4.0 54.0/59.6/59.1%. Sol xhigh matches Astra high on terminal coding at much lower API task cost, so Astra is no longer a large default step above Sol. Omniscience max accuracy 62.6%, hallucination 51.3%; not uniformly the most reliable model. Historical local median 15 s per turn (p90 65 s). AA API task costs $1.73/$2.31/$3.26 are not Codex quota usage. Two account routes; manual fixed reviewer remains Astra high.

fable.profile: Last-resort Claude alternative when Opus and Sonnet are unavailable. No new evaluation in the Sept 29 comparison. Older Sept 28 results showed no clear advantage over Opus and local median 12-15 s per turn with large tail latency. Has its own extra weekly limit. Do not prefer it over freshly evaluated models without task-specific evidence.

modelData: AA Intelligence Index v4.3.2, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SciCode, and API costs retrieved 2026-09-29; sources and limits in research/gpt-6.1-sol-routing.md. Effort labels are not equal compute budgets. AA API prices/latency are not local timings or subscription quota measurements. Historical local timings are from 2026-09-28 and never apply to new Sol 6.1. Fable was not re-evaluated. Profiles define task priorities, not a universal ranking.
